topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out that you're moving across the country. It feels like everything’s changing, and I can't help but think about all the times we promised to stick together, no matter what. I’m going to miss those spontaneous road trips and late-night talks over coffee. The idea of not being able to drop by and just hang out whenever feels... overwhelming. I guess what I’m trying to say is, even though I’m thrilled for your new adventure, it’s going to be tough here without you. I hope we can still keep in touch, maybe set up video calls or something. Just promise me we won’t let the miles come between us.
